style.title: 🎨 Style Lock (keep a series consistent)
style.note: Tune the generation parameters below and press "Capture current parameters", fill in the style prefix and seed, then turn the lock on. Every generation afterwards (including batches) uses the same settings. Note: a fixed seed stabilizes composition and color, but results can still differ between prompts; pair it with a fixed checkpoint / LoRA.
style.promptLabel: Style prefix prompt (added to the front of every prompt)
style.promptPlaceholder: e.g. flat vector illustration, thick outline, pastel palette, game asset
style.negativeLabel: Style negative prompt (appended to the negative prompt)
style.enable: Enable style lock (locks Steps / CFG / Sampler / Checkpoint / LoRA / Seed fields)
style.batchLabel: Batch asset list (one per line, up to {max})
style.append: Also append the prompt built above (camera, scene tags, etc.)
style.noParams: No parameters captured yet. Tune the generation parameters below, then press "Capture current parameters".
